caption: The drawing consists of a single large, bold, black symbol centered on a plain white background. The symbol appears to be a stylized combination of curved and straight lines, forming an abstract shape that resembles a blend of the letters “J” and “G.” The vertical stroke is straight and thick, with a curling hook at the top and a curved segment that wraps partially around the lower part of the figure. The drawing is minimal in composition, with no other objects, shading, or colors present except for the black of the symbol and the white of the paper. The edges of the symbol are smooth and the lines are uniform in thickness. The symbol is positioned roughly in the center of the paper, with ample white space on all sides.
